_🚀 Performance & Scalability_ | _🟠 Major_ | _🏗️ Heavy lift_

**Do not silently switch from sampling to full persistence.**

When `redisTemplate` is absent, every replay is stored and all sampling counters are skipped. Under the current cache-disabled configuration, this turns sampling into 100% MongoDB writes and increases database load. Make “store all” an explicit SPT-only mode or provide a bounded local fallback with an observable metric.







Also applies to: 92-94

```
around lines 40 - 43, Update shouldStoreTradeReplay so a null redisTemplate does
not implicitly return true and bypass sampling counters. Preserve full
persistence only for an explicit SPT-only configuration; otherwise use a bounded
local sampling fallback and emit an observable metric when Redis is unavailable,
including the analogous handling in the later redis-dependent branch.
```

</details>

The key is only `#portfolioId`, but the result shape depends on `includeTradeDetails` (lines 97-99 populate `tradeDetails`/`winTrades`/`lossTrades` only when `true`). A first call with `includeTradeDetails=false` caches a stripped result that a later `true` call will then receive (and vice versa). Include the flag in the key.
